sources.entry: Claude Statistics - Native macOS menu bar app for monitoring Claude Code session usage, token costs, and Anthropic subscription limits in real time.

summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app that monitors Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI sessions, subscription usage, tokens, and cost analytics in real time.
keywords: see how much i spent on claude
summary.what_it_does: Reads local transcript files from ~/.claude/projects/, ~/.codex/projects/, and ~/.gemini/tmp/ to list sessions with model, token counts, cost, context usage, and timestamps. It provides a full transcript viewer with search and match navigation. Statistics are shown as all-time totals and daily, weekly, or monthly aggregates with cost charts and cache-token breakdowns. It fetches live subscription usage windows for Claude (5-hour and 7-day), Gemini quota buckets, and Codex plan context. A "Notch Island" surface docked to the MacBook notch shows active sessions and can display permission cards and jump focus to the terminal tab. A plugin marketplace installs .csplugin bundles, and the app can generate shareable stat cards.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code token usage and cost from the menu bar
browse and search past Claude Code conversations
review daily, weekly, or monthly AI coding spend
resume or jump back to a running coding session in its terminal
track Codex CLI or Gemini CLI usage alongside Claude
how_to_run: Download the latest .dmg from Releases and drag Claude Statistics into Applications
If macOS blocks launch (app is not notarized), run: xattr -cr /Applications/Claude\ Statistics.app
git clone the repository and cd into claude-statistics
Run open ClaudeStatistics.xcodeproj and build in Xcode
For local debug runs: bash scripts/run-debug.sh
notable: Notch Island: live session panel docked to the MacBook notch with inline Allow/Deny permission cards for Claude Code hooks
Ghostty tab-accurate focus that jumps to the exact tab a session runs in, with iTerm2, Terminal.app, Kitty, WezTerm, and Alacritty routing
Multi-provider menu bar strip showing Claude, Codex, and Gemini usage side by side, colour-coded at 50% and 80%
Plugin marketplace that installs .csplugin bundles verified by SHA-256
Local-first parsing: analytics computed from transcripts on your machine
caveats: Not notarized by Apple, so macOS may block the first launch and require a workaround
Building from source requires Xcode 16 and XcodeGen
